name: n8n-nodes-solar-sm
description: Solar LLM and Embeddings nodes for n8n

scripts.build: tsc && npm run copy-assets && npm run copy-index
scripts.copy-assets: cp src/upstage.svg src/upstage_v2.svg dist/ && cp src/nodes/LmChatUpstage/upstage_v2.svg dist/nodes/LmChatUpstage/ && cp src/nodes/EmbeddingsUpstage/upstage_v2.svg dist/nodes/EmbeddingsUpstage/ && cp src/nodes/LmChatModelUpstage/upstage_v2.svg dist/nodes/LmChatModelUpstage/ && cp src/nodes/EmbeddingsUpstageModel/upstage_v2.svg dist/nodes/EmbeddingsUpstageModel/ || true
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
